onboarding.slide1Body: Add your SPM, UEC, A-Levels, IB or any qualification a single time — we instantly match you with institutions in 7 countries.

onboarding.slide3Body: Build your document vault, apply in minutes, and follow every application from submission to visa letter.

assistant.title: UniBridge Assistant
assistant.greeting: Hi {{name}} 👋 I'm your study-abroad assistant. Ask me about any university or city — weather, safety, living costs — or let me help you decide what and where to study. I answer from your real match results.
assistant.greetingShort: Hi {{name}}! What would you like to know?
assistant.disclaimer: Answers come from UniBridge prototype data — indicative, not live advice.
assistant.entrySub: Weather, safety, costs, or "what should I study?"
assistant.studyAsk: Let's find your field — tap one below, or just type it in your own words (e.g. "I like fashion" or "maybe marketing").
assistant.whereAsk: Let's narrow it down — what matters most to you?
assistant.budgetAsk: Roughly how much can you spend per year — tuition and living together?
assistant.budgetAnswer: With {{amount}} per year, {{count}} of your eligible courses fit the budget. The best value:
assistant.budgetNone: No fully-eligible course fits {{amount}} per year yet — but these are your cheapest eligible options for reference:
assistant.budgetNote: Amounts are true cost — tuition plus rent, food and transport.
assistant.recommendStudy: Based on your {{system}} results, here's where you stand:
assistant.recommendWhere: Here are your strongest options there:
assistant.noMatches: I couldn't find matching courses for that — try another direction or loosen your filters.
assistant.openMatchHint: Open the Match tab to see every option and compare them.
assistant.instAnswer: {{name}} is a {{type}} in {{city}}, {{country}} — {{tagline}}. On UniBridge: {{count}} courses, true cost ≈{{min}}–{{max}} per year for you. Official site: {{website}}
assistant.cityCost: Living in {{city}} costs about {{total}} a month ({{homeTotal}}): rent {{rent}}, food {{food}}, transport {{transport}}.
assistant.askCity: Which city are you curious about?
assistant.fallback: I can help with universities, cities (weather, safety, costs), budgets, and choosing what or where to study. Try one of these:
assistant.wizardFieldUnknown: I didn't catch a field in that — try your own words like "hotel work", "coding", "become a teacher", or tap one:
assistant.wizardAskBudget: Nice — {{field}} it is. Next: roughly how much can you spend per year (tuition + living)? Type an amount or pick one:
assistant.wizardAskPref: Last one — what kind of place suits you?
assistant.wizardRelaxed: Note: nothing fit that budget, so I loosened it to show your closest options.
assistant.cityFlight: ✈️ Flights home, round trip: about {{low}} in low season · {{peak}} in peak/holiday season.
